A '''line regiment''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
A line regiment was comprised of two [[line battalion]]s, an [[assault battalion]], and a [[repulsorlift battalion]], and a [[regimental headquarters]]. A line regiment's strength was 3,530 personnel supported by 130 [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]]. Line regiments were generally deployed on planets where low level resistance was expected.<ref name="ISB" />

The [[COMPNOR Regiment]] was nearly identical to the line regiment's design. With the main exception being the lack of five security platoons.<ref name="ISB" />

Line regiments could be augmented by the addition of another line battalion, an assault battalion, a repulsorlift battalion, and an [[artillery battalion]].<ref name="ISB2" />
